description: Keep a lesson learned in this project, so the next session knows it: when the same Godot message or question comes back, godot_check and godot_lessons show your fix. Write it in general words: `title` in one line, `fix` what to do; add `symptom`, `cause`, `error` (the Godot message as printed), `topic`, `tags`, `rules` and `test` when you can. Project names, paths, links, e-mail addresses, codes, keys and source code are replaced before anything is stored; a lesson that is mostly names is refused with what to change. The same title again updates that lesson. It writes only to the local learning file and is never sent. Add one whenever a fix took more than one try, not for what a review rule already reports. Returns the stored lesson and what was replaced; an error when it is refused or learning is off.

error.description: the Godot message it explains, as printed

rules.description: review or model rule ids it belongs to

symptom.description: what went wrong, as it showed

title.description: the lesson in one line, e.g. 'A body placed on a moving deck must start at the deck speed'

name: godot_lesson_add
title: Keep a lesson learned here
